svg.title: A rest in the rhythm
svg.desc: Beside a graduated spine on a base plate sit seven evenly spaced stations: six round pads and, in the middle, an open collar the size of a pad with a lamp sunk inside. A carriage on the spine stops over the collar for exactly one beat, as it does over every pad; nothing is struck there and the collar glows: the pause is counted. The ticks keep the same spacing on both sides of it.
